patch.value: Resolve human-agent decisions in a shared inbox

Collaborative web workflow over core Plan decisions with alternatives, evidence and audited SDK responses. Concurrent responses use revision checks; view-only users cannot apply; acknowledgments never count as code review or task completion. Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, remedies, docs, no-git and public tracker validation, browser screenshots.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked against installed CLI 2026.10.21 and pinned SDK 2026.10.19: core plan decision stores decision text, rationale and evidence; no pending request workflow. Sibling pm-review owns typed review findings/verdicts and remote review completion. pm-jev owns model proposals. This feature adds a versioned web workflow within existing Plan decision logs, without another item type, review verdict, execution approval or completion model. Search inbox returned no existing package item. Tracker-reconciliation items are excluded. Plan: shared typed service, bounded CLI/HTTP, revision checks inside SDK cross-process lock, existing audited planDecision mutations, accessible comparison UI, real no-git/concurrency/refusal tests, public corpus read-only measurements, screenshots and CI npm/Bun release gates.
